description: This PHP script defines a function `additionalDetailsProspect` that generates an HTML summary of a prospect's details for display, based on input fields. It utilizes global variables and functions related to SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, and references language strings and URLs for email actions.

methods.name: additionalDetailsProspect
methods.description: Generates an HTML snippet with prospect details, including address, phone numbers, email addresses, and description. It conditionally appends information based on provided fields and references language strings for labels.
